Dear [Miss Medhurst](/person/988)
I like your New Year’s Eve poem, but I ought to have had it long ago.
If you have not disposed of it otherwise, will you send it to me next October for December of 1873.
I believe [Mrs Mercier](/person/990) has put a little pupil of mine under your care as member of the Guild [Emmeline Spratt](/person/1358). She is a really good girl I believe, and very affectionate but I should not wonder if you thought her a little sentimental	

Yours truly

C M Yonge
